summary: Initial DFM review surfaced five rule violations dominated by under-spec wall thickness and missing draft.
decision: Reject the candidate design and request a revision addressing all listed rule violations.

dfx_rule_analysis.explanation: wall_thickness_mm=1.1 < 1.5 mm minimum for ABS injection molding.
draft_angle_deg=0.5 < 1.0 minimum, will cause ejection drag.
has_undercut=true and side-action tooling not justified.
internal_radius_mm=0.2 < 0.5 mm, sharp corner will concentrate stress.

final_recommendation: Increase wall to 1.6 mm, draft to 1.2 deg, remove undercut, fillet to >=0.5 mm, and shrink bosses to <= 2.5x wall.
